counterexample_attempts: The modal construction at ambient d=101 is valid: constant modal labels give ε=Θ(log p/(p log log p)) while every total-degree-at-most-101 polynomial has agreement below 2/p. This refutes a uniform Cd/p trigger with linear recovery.
The diffuse-support example is valid: f=0 and line polynomials with d distinct roots give ε=d/p and σ=1, while Q=0 has perfect global agreement. It refutes inferring σ=O(ε), not soundness.
The homogeneous-direction construction is not an obstruction: Q=0 agrees on 1+(d+1)(p−1) points, matching the Θ(d/p) local scale.
B=Z²−X² validly demonstrates branch collision where B_Z=0. It justifies simplicity for this propagation method, but not the universal necessity of deletion in every conceivable proof.
The inseparability attempt is correctly excluded: D
The near-p information-set calculation is valid and supplies a positive baseline rather than a counterexample.

exponent_audit.claim: Carrier pruning loses no power of δ.
exponent_audit.justification: The two normalized deletion costs are k0/(p+1) and k0/p, totaling less than δ/50.

exponent_audit.claim: The selector has size r=O(σp/δ) without an additional probabilistic δ-loss.
exponent_audit.justification: Hoeffding applies to independent coverage indicators along each target line; the union bound and Chebyshev estimates give 100(p+1)≤r≤6400σp/δ.
The dimension is at least D³/(64d), while the r line identities impose at most r(D+1) equations. The chosen D satisfies D²>256dr.
The premise and σ≥δ give δ²≥10^15d/p. Hence D≤1280δp/sqrt(10^15)+16<δp/10000; the premise also makes δp large enough to absorb the additive 16 and all floor losses.
Combining D=O(sqrt(dσp/δ)) with D=O(δp) and squaring gives δ³=Ω(dσ/p).

exponent_audit.claim: Content and resultant deletion preserve the cubic scale.
exponent_audit.justification: The losses are bounded by D/[p(p+1)]+D(D−1)/[p(p+1)]+D/p. The D/p term again requires D=O(δp); the quadratic term alone only requires δ²=Ω(dσ/p).

exponent_audit.claim: The mixing gate is weaker than the cubic gate.
exponent_audit.justification: The cubic premise implies (p+1)^−1/2<δ/8000≤k1/(4p). No additional exponent loss occurs.

exponent_audit.claim: The written component-mixing proof establishes point density δ/8000.
exponent_audit.justification: The result is correct, but the stated consequences do not themselves contradict the lower bounds; two substitutions back into e≤ab+u√(ab) are omitted.

exponent_audit.claim: The unconditional exponent is exactly 1/3 and is not improved.
For fixed A, σ≤Aδ yields a conditional exponent 1/2.
exponent_audit.justification: The sufficient condition becomes δ²≥10^15Ad/p. Because 0<d/p<1, (d/p)^(1/2)<(d/p)^(1/3), so 1/2 is stronger than 1/3, but only under the extra carrier hypothesis.

exponent_audit.claim: The modal probability exponents and exact-linear obstruction are correct.
exponent_audit.justification: McDiarmid gives exp(−1250r²); the polynomial union bound gives p^5253(e/4)^p; their exceptional probabilities are below r/(520p). The resulting global/local ratio is at most 260/r→0.

summary: REVISE. The exact required SHA was audited. The core support-sensitive theorem, prime-field B_Z lemma, cubic exponent ledger, modal obstruction, and single-polynomial strategy appear mathematically correct, with no fatal counterexample. Strict acceptance fails because the exact statement leaves key context and A unquantified, P8 omits the algebra completing both mixing contradictions, the propagation citation omits KTZ Lemma 6.3, and P18 overstates the universal necessity of deletion. All defects are repairable without weakening the mathematical claim.
verified_exponent: Unconditional exponent 1/3 (not improved); conditional exponent 1/2 only for fixed σ≤Aδ; a uniform exact exponent-1 trigger Cd/p with linear recovery is refuted.
